notes.title: Early Access Release Announcement
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce that my game will be entering Early Access in the next quarter! As a solo developer, this marks a significant milestone for me, and I'm eager to share this journey with all of you. Early Access will allow me to gather valuable feedback from the community as I continue to refine and enhance the game.

Currently, I'm focused on extensive testing to ensure that the game delivers the best possible experience. I'm fine-tuning various aspects, from game-play mechanics to visual elements, to make sure everything feels just right.

However, I want to be transparent with you about one of the challenges I'm currently facing. There's an issue with the sound in the current build that doesn’t quite match the immersive experience I aim to provide. Rest assured, I'm dedicating significant time and effort to resolving this, and I'm confident that with your feedback during Early Access, I’ll be able to perfect this critical component.

I can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see how we can make the game even better together. Thank you for your support and enthusiasm—let's embark on this adventure together!

Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to launch.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 : Small enhancement
notes.notes:
Hello dear players,

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43693880/371ddb76b7586bfbae7e31235dc6e455779ef954.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43693880/4acbc00c1f3549697521c0349f41db44934443a4.png[/img][/url]

First and foremost, we want to apologize for not previously including a keyboard guide within our game. We understand the importance of accessibility and ease of use, and we are happy to announce that a keyboard guide has now been added!

We would like to also introduce a new user interface feature: a kill scoreboard! This will allow you to keep track of the number of kills you've accomplished throughout your gameplay. However, please note that the sorting feature for this is still under development, and we'll be working on improving it in upcoming patches.

In the meantime, we encourage you to explore these new features and share your feedback with us. Your opinions are crucial in helping us improve the game for everyone.

As always, thank you for your continued support. We hope you enjoy the new updates!

Best,
Abdulrahman

notes.title: Join the Excitement with Crazy Cars' Demo Release at Steam Next Fest: June 2023
notes.notes:
Calling all gaming enthusiasts! As we approach the much-anticipated Steam Next Fest in June 2023, we are excited to invite you to experience the thrill and adrenaline of our action-packed racing game, Crazy Cars, with an exclusive demo release.

Crazy Cars is not your typical racing game. It is a playground of fast-paced action and vehicular combat where you can unleash your driving prowess. Get behind the wheel of custom vehicles, armed with power-ups and special abilities, and let your competitive spirit roar.

Take this opportunity to be among the first to test drive Crazy Cars during the Steam Next Fest. We can't wait for you to join us on this exhilarating journey and look forward to hearing your feedback on the demo. Fasten your seatbelts and get ready for a wild ride!

Stay tuned for more updates, and see you on the race track!
